parts:
Hello,
I'm trying to make the download button save a file which originally was a .tab, got some changes done with data.table and gets correctly displayed on the main panel. However, when I try to save the result in any format (desired is .xlsx) I get the promt to save it as expected but nothing really gets saved. Could someone copy or give me a link of an example about a shiny app which allows such a download (not just downloading a dataset from base R? I'm very new to shiny and to R too. thank you!

Before trying anything else, can you do this?

if (!require(devtools))
  install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("rstudio/shiny")

Then restart R and try again. It's possible you are hitting a bug we fixed recently. Otherwise, it'd be very helpful if you could provide a reproducible example of what you're trying so we can tell you how to fix it.
